manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: Saved process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, Open workflow, then printed-replacement-part-common-digital-083.workflow.wflow.

manualSteps.label: Common view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Inspect the original inputs and any readiness reason.

manualSteps.label: Run
manualSteps.instruction: Click Prepare and check inputs, then Start process. Inspect the recorded digital results; reload to reconcile the same run.
